axel_chasserant: The draft reached R-S5 on Day 8. Viktor "Button" Chasserant was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Viktor "Button" Chasserant offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Viktor "Button" Chasserant fought Dietrich Dependentkin in a trench no wider than a door. Viktor "Button" Chasserant came home with Dietrich Dependentkin's cap badge. (@dependentkink_____) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Viktor "Button" Chasserant hit Felix Zulfi with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@rayan.zulfi) The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Viktor "Button" Chasserant read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
comrade_pawington: The new rifleman is Konrad "Mud" Pawington, once a coal miner from Millbank. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Konrad "Mud" Pawington said he would find out.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Walter "Saint" Williemcminn, grazed. Konrad "Mud" Pawington cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Konrad "Mud" Pawington felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F10. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Konrad Manthatsment of the Concord (@manthatsmental1). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Konrad "Mud" Pawington shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
ditrih_88: The new rifleman gave his name as Marek Ditrih. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
First Wave. Marek Ditrih signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a bullet that missed him.

Dorian Austintress lent Marek Ditrih a pencil. The returned pencil came wrapped in a scrap of paper marked 'One good turn'. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Marek Ditrih looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A shell landed close to R-F12. When the dust settled Marek Ditrih was still there, holding a bullet that missed him, laughing without sound.
Marek Ditrih cut Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.

Dawn watch. Marek Ditrih put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, grazed. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Marek Ditrih folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Marek Ditrih fired at a movement across the wire at R-F12. The man went down: Dietrich Jackson, grazed.
A clear shot from R-F12. Marek Ditrih grazed Karel Pavla and slid back down below the parapet.
Asked what he will do after the war, Marek Ditrih said: 'Be a postman in Old Harrow. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Marek Ditrih saved the last of the sugar for Dorian Austintress's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Dorian's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Marek Ditrih walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
dj_triplejjj1120: "You're late," said the corporal when Teodor Triplejjj arrived on Day 4. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Isidor Serrano's name scratched on it. Teodor Triplejjj kicked it back. It did not come again.

Teodor Triplejjj accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Teodor Triplejjj wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Teodor Triplejjj raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F20. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Leopold Staryfins of the Hegemony (@staryfins).
A bullet found Teodor Triplejjj at S-F20, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Bastian "Crow" Jwger of the Hegemony (@jwger87).
The medics would not give up on Teodor Triplejjj. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F20 today.
Teodor Triplejjj pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Calvary Farm and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Teodor Triplejjj looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
j14ar08g06: The quartermaster asked Valentin Jarg to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

Valentin Jarg and Arno Isaacburston argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Valentin Jarg wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Valentin Jarg checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.
Valentin Jarg took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.

A bullet struck Valentin Jarg below the ribs at R-F1. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Gustav "Brick" Floooring of the Hegemony (@carpet.floooring). A single shot at R-F1. Valentin Jarg sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Gustav "Brick" Floooring of the Hegemony (@carpet.floooring).
Pavel "Bones" Jarg had heard about Valentin Jarg's courage. At R-F1, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Lightning lit Blackwater Canal and Pavel "Bones" Jarg saw the enemy wire, the enemy trench, and a man in it looking straight back.

Pavel "Bones" Jarg was on the dawn watch at R-F1 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Pavel "Bones" Jarg was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Pavel "Bones" Jarg watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
jimjamjom_: Florian Jimjamjom arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
jiri.satalik: Bram Satalik took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Bram Satalik was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Bram Satalik put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Bram Satalik during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A bullet clipped Bram Satalik's helmet at R-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Bram Ahmadhcj of the Hegemony (@ahmadhcj07).
Bram Satalik's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

Bram Satalik watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Bram Satalik wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Bram Satalik left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.

A bullet went through Bram Satalik's sleeve at R-F11 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Hugo Xiii of the Hegemony (@masis_xiii). Bram Satalik fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Bram Satalik is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Bram Satalik raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_).

Bram Satalik's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F11 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bram Satalik helped stack spare sandbags at R-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
nathanielenzo_073: Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz unpacked a photograph gone soft at the edges at R-C7. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
pansinik.37: Cyril "Mud" Pansinik introduced himself as a glassblower from Northwick. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Cyril "Mud" Pansinik let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
stickus_b: Roland Stickus introduced himself as a clockmaker from Oakmere. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-S10 with the rations. Roland Stickus ate while listening to the revised orders.
stinchgaming25: Isidor Stinchgaming told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

The flare went up just as Isidor Stinchgaming reached the Concord parapet. Isidor Stinchgaming jumped down first. Wendel "Whistle" Luxos was the man waiting there, and Wendel "Whistle" Luxos fell. (@luxos8000) The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Isidor Stinchgaming did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
ta7mira2: Jonas Mira came up on Day 9 carrying news from Dunmarrow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Jonas Mira looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
tawt_us: Viktor "Owl" Tawt arrived at Q-F4 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Viktor "Owl" Tawt wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
wihanholtzhauzen: "You're late," said the corporal when Leopold Wihanholtzha arrived on Day 8. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Felix Crobus lent Leopold Wihanholtzha a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S1, Leopold Wihanholtzha listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
yurboixav: Wendel Yurboixav took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Wendel Yurboixav was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Wendel Yurboixav did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Machine-gun fire swept S-F11. Wendel Yurboixav took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Arno Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy).
An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Wendel Yurboixav was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.

The man in the next bed snored all day. Wendel Yurboixav did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Wendel Yurboixav watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The field hospital let Wendel Yurboixav go. He came back up the line on foot because the truck would not wait.
Wendel Yurboixav was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Wendel Yurboixav heard a faint second conversation on the telephone line. Headquarters said only one line was connected.
A round went through the rim of Wendel Yurboixav's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Edmund Matteozrybak of the Hegemony (@matteozrybak).

Wendel Yurboixav rejoined the squad at S-F11. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-F11 with the rations. Wendel Yurboixav ate while listening to the revised orders.
